title: Estate-wide Learnability State Schema
description: Estate-wide state schema (all skills) for tracking skill load, atrophy risk, and autonomy across the Motivational Ecology Agent Architecture. Canonical per-skill metric is skill_load_score (0..1); skill_load_trend is DERIVED from it (T2R_traceability.json canonical_state_variables: PPS writes skill_load_score, HEB derives skill_load_trend; aliases skill_load_metric (T2R) unified here). Evidence discipline: every threshold and rule carries VERIFIED / RECONSTRUCTED / UNVERIFIED flag. Grounding: Theory_to_Routine_Interface.md (skill_load_metric row, RECONSTRUCTED; readiness_gate row), Proximal_Practice_Selector SKILL.md, Recent_Evidence_Digest.md, Contrary_Findings_and_Limits.md.

estate_id.description: Identifier of the estate (user/profile) this snapshot covers.

generated_at.description: Snapshot timestamp. Each estate sweep writes a new snapshot; do not mutate history in place.

skills.description: Per-skill learnability state. One entry per tracked skill/capability in the estate (all skills, not only practice skills).

evidence.description: Evidence register for this schema: the VERIFIED anchors and the RECONSTRUCTED operationalizations built on them.

telemetry_policy.description: The telemetry-vs-self-report rule. Objective telemetry is the preferred and primary basis for every capability decision; self-report is flagged unreliable and may only contextualize, never drive.

preference.const: objective telemetry preferred over self-report for all skill_load, atrophy, and fade decisions

self_report_status.const: unreliable for capability estimation; flagged and de-weighted

rationale.description: Why telemetry is decision-grade and self-report is not: Lee 2025 (VERIFIED) confidence-in-GenAI predicts less critical-thinking effort; users metacognitively blind (Bastani 2025 perception data).

flag.description: Lee 2025 (CHI, N=319, VERIFIED): confidence in GenAI predicts LESS critical-thinking effort; over-reliance dominant; users are metacognitively blind to capability decline (Bastani 2025 perception data confirms).

self_report_uses.description: Self-report is admitted ONLY for these uses. It never sets skill_load_score, never classifies atrophy_risk, and never triggers or cancels a fade by itself.

source.description: Objective telemetry channel, e.g. task outcomes, assistance mode, completion, timing, initiator.

skill_state.description: Per-skill learnability state. Mirrors and extends the Proximal_Practice_Selector state_schema.json variables at estate scale; keeps assisted_performance_track and unassisted_competence_track strictly separate (separate_performance_capability).

skill_id.description: Canonical skill/capability identifier (package skill id, or user capability id where no package exists).

skill_load_score.description: CANONICAL skill-load metric (0..1): share of completed tasks completed unassisted in the window. Operationalization per Theory_to_Routine_Interface.md skill_load_metric row (RECONSTRUCTED, campaign-proposed: 'share of tasks completed unassisted, tracked'; first-class metric of the learnability layer). Computed as unassisted_completed / total_completed; equals 1 - assistance_fraction when denominators align. Written by PPS compute_skill_load.

skill_load_trend.description: DERIVED from skill_load_score over comparison windows (T2R_traceability.json: HEB derives skill_load_trend; this schema resolves the Phase-4 unification by making skill_load_score canonical and skill_load_trend always derived). Never recorded independently of score history.

baseline_performance.description: Baseline window outcomes (pre-intervention / earliest window with sufficient telemetry).

recent_performance.description: Recent window outcomes (rolling window ending at snapshot). Comparison of recent vs baseline drives detect_atrophy_risk.

assisted_performance_track.description: Assisted outcomes, kept SEPARATE from capability (Brynjolfsson 2025 VERIFIED +14% productivity coexists with Bastani 2025 VERIFIED -17% capability: performance gain and capability erosion are different measures; conflation is how deskilling becomes invisible).

unassisted_competence_track.description: Unassisted outcomes, the capability record. Calibration instrument for the user's benefit, never a verdict on the user (Beacock 2026 VERIFIED: perceived agency can decouple from actual capacity).

assistance_fraction.description: Per-skill assisted tasks / total tasks in window. Rising assistance_fraction with stable or falling unassisted capability is the Budzyn/Bastani warning signature.

unassisted_completion_rate.description: Quality-side metric: unassisted_successes / unassisted_attempts. Distinct from skill_load_score (share of tasks completed unassisted); both telemetry-derived. Declines here drive atrophy classification.

last_practice.description: Timestamp of last practice/relevant task engagement for this skill. Long gaps feed Eiroa-Solans 2025 decay logic (24h decay, VERIFIED).

practice_frequency.description: Spacing/dose summary, e.g. '3 sessions/week' or '1 session / 4.2 days'. Used by select_practice_dose to counter 24h decay (Eiroa-Solans 2025).

source_basis.description: What this skill's record is built on. telemetry = trusted for decisions; self_report = unreliable (Lee 2025 VERIFIED); mixed = telemetry fields are decision-grade, self-report fields context-only.

atrophy_risk.description: Risk classification per skill_atrophy_risk_check.md pipeline (compute -> compare -> separate performance from capability -> classify). Criteria in this schema's thresholds.risk_classification.

empowerment_ratio.description: INVERSE METRIC (counterweight): user_initiated_actions / agent_initiated_actions for this skill. Measures autonomy, not just completion. Null when agent_initiated_actions == 0 (record flag 'all_user_initiated'). High skill_load_score + high empowerment_ratio = capability growth AND autonomy; high skill_load_score + low empowerment_ratio = completion without autonomy (Beacock 2026 VERIFIED 'empowerment theater' risk; von Foerster choice-increasing imperative). RECONSTRUCTED (campaign-proposed).

readiness_state.description: PPS readiness_state carried through (Liu CHI 2026 VERIFIED: aligned-adaptive timing +21% accuracy, FN 50.9%->22.9%). Gates TIMING only, never autonomous action (Shaikh 2026 VERIFIED: next-action alignment 17.1-26%).

scaffold_level_current.description: Current scaffold level (0 = none .. 5 = full), per PPS state_schema.json.

fade_schedule.description: Planned fades with dates/conditions. A scaffold that never fades is dependency by design (PPS guardrail).

preserved_user_decision.description: What remains with the user; if the user prefers assistance and understands the tradeoff, record it here and downgrade atrophy classification accordingly (see preference_classification).

initiator.description: Who initiated the action; feeds empowerment_ratio.

preference_classification.description: Separates preference from atrophy (Contrary_Findings section D: hypothesis status, not doctrine; user-correctable). The user CAN do X but chooses not to = preference, NOT atrophy.

classification.description: atrophy = capability declined despite opportunity/attempts; preference = demonstrated capability with chosen assistance (or chosen non-practice); unclassified = insufficient evidence, treat as preference until proven otherwise (presumption favors the user).

basis.description: Evidence trail: demonstrated unassisted capability (recent unassisted successes), stated preference, preserved_user_decision record, or absence of attempts.

flag.description: Operational rule grounded in Contrary_Findings B1 (Brynjolfsson 2025 +14% performance vs Bastani 2025 -17% capability are different measures) and D1 (inferences are labeled, user-correctable, outcome-arbitrated). No source defines a validated preference-vs-atrophy test.

mean_skill_load.description: Mean of per-skill skill_load_score across the estate.

median_skill_load.description: Median; more robust than mean under a few collapsed skills.

at_risk_skills.description: Skills classified medium or high (or falling-without-preference). Each entry carries the trigger evidence so no at-risk flag is a bare assertion.

trigger_evidence.description: e.g. 'skill_load_score 0.62 -> 0.41 over 3 windows', 'unassisted_completion_rate -18pp vs baseline', 'assistance_fraction 0.35 -> 0.71', 'Budzyn-pattern: sustained AI use without fade'.

dependency_ratio.description: Estate-wide assisted tasks / total tasks. The estate mirror of per-skill assistance_fraction; rising dependency_ratio is the early estate-level warning that the Budzyn pattern is generalizing.

estate_empowerment_ratio.description: Estate-wide user_initiated_actions / agent_initiated_actions. Counterweight to mean_skill_load: the estate is healthy only if capability AND autonomy both hold.

thresholds.description: Decision thresholds. Every rule carries its evidence flag. None of the numeric cutoffs is study-validated; they are RECONSTRUCTED operationalizations anchored on VERIFIED findings, and must be treated as calibration, not doctrine (Contrary_Findings D1).

rule.description: A falling skill_load_trend over >= 2 consecutive comparison windows (or >= 3 telemetry points) triggers review for that skill.

grounding.description: Budzyn 2025 (Lancet, VERIFIED): endoscopist ADR 28.4% -> 22.4% after sustained AI use — reversion is gradual, trend-level. Bastani 2025 (PNAS, VERIFIED): -17% post-access capability — decline is invisible until measured. Trend, not point, is the failure signature.

rule.description: A single-point dip does NOT trigger review or change scaffolding. Minimum evidence: 2 windows or 3 telemetry points before any classification.

grounding.description: Shaikh 2026 (VERIFIED): next-action alignment only 17.1-26% — single observations are low-confidence and noisy; acting on one dip manufactures false alarms and breaks trust (Liu CHI 2026: false-negative reduction 50.9% -> 22.9% was the win; premature intervention is the cost).

rule.description: Before classifying atrophy, separate performance from capability and check preference signals. User can do X but chooses not to (stated preference, or preserved_user_decision) = preference, not atrophy. Presumption favors preference when evidence is ambiguous.

grounding.description: Contrary_Findings B1 (VERIFIED both): Brynjolfsson +14% productivity vs Bastani -17% capability are different measures; D1: inferences are labeled, user-correctable, outcome-arbitrated — never doctrine. Autonomy preservation is a hard boundary (Contrary_Findings D4).

risk_classification.description: Precise classification criteria used by skill_atrophy_risk_check.md step 4. Numeric cutoffs are RECONSTRUCTED calibration anchors.

examples.criteria: Trend flat or rising; unassisted_completion_rate >= baseline; assistance_fraction stable or falling.
Single-point dip only (no trend); OR assistance_fraction rising with stable unassisted capability and an explicit preference signal (preserved_user_decision).
Falling trend over >= 2 windows AND unassisted_completion_rate >= 10pp below baseline (RECONSTRUCTED cutoff) AND no established preference signal. Scaffold fade slows; readiness_gate re-evaluated.

Falling trend AND unassisted_completion_rate >= 10pp below baseline AND assistance_fraction rising (or sustained AI use without fade — Budzyn pattern) AND no preserved_user_decision. Fade STOPS; scaffolds re-added; readiness_gate re-evaluated; Human_Empowerment_Boundary consulted.

finding.description: Budzyn 2025 (Lancet Gastroenterology, VERIFIED): endoscopists reverted to non-AI after sustained AI use; ADR fell 28.4% -> 22.4%.

use.description: Canonical warning. Sustained assistance without fade, without separate capability tracking, and without telemetry is treated as the Budzyn pattern until proven otherwise. 'Fade without measurement: no skill-load data means no fade decision is defensible' (PPS failure modes).
